gloss: promotion based on merit; merit-based appointment

definitions.gloss: promotion based on merit; merit-based appointment; selection of someone for a position above their seniority
definitions.explanation: A personnel decision in which someone is promoted or appointed to a position not based on seniority but on their ability and achievements. Often involves skipping over more senior colleagues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{抜擢人事|ばってきじんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧になった。
examples.english: A young employee was promoted to department head through a merit-based appointment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜擢人事|ばってきじんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: This merit-based promotion became a talking point within the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{抜擢人事|ばってきじんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More companies are emphasizing merit-based appointments over seniority-based promotions.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{抜擢|ばってき}→抜擢：07946_batteki⟧ (selection based on talent, singling out) + ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧ (personnel affairs, HR decisions). Refers to promoting someone ahead of more senior colleagues based on their demonstrated ability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抜擢人事|ばってきじんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out a merit-based appointment
- {抜擢人事|ばってきじんじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted through merit
- ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜擢人事|ばってきじんじ}: an exceptional merit-based promotion

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{抜擢|ばってき}→抜擢：07946_batteki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to select based on merit, to single out for promotion
- ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧: seniority-based system — the traditional Japanese system where promotions follow years of service
- ⟦{人事異動|じんじいどう}→人事異動：18627_jinjiidou⟧: personnel transfer, reshuffle
- ⟦{登用|とうよう}→登用：17153_touyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint, to employ — similar meaning but without the connotation of skipping seniority

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan's traditionally seniority-based (⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧) corporate culture, {抜擢人事|ばってきじんじ} is notable because it breaks from convention. It has become increasingly common as Japanese companies shift toward performance-based systems.
